steps.title: applied
steps.done_when: the agent reports applied.md; its checks exit 0
steps.command: shas=$(grep -oE '\b[0-9a-f]{7,40}\b' .moor/artifacts/applied.md | sort -u); [ -n "$shas" ] && for s in $shas; do git cat-file -e "$s^{commit}" || exit 1; done

checks.run: shas=$(grep -oE '\b[0-9a-f]{7,40}\b' .moor/artifacts/applied.md | sort -u); [ -n "$shas" ] && for s in $shas; do git cat-file -e "$s^{commit}" || exit 1; done
checks.says: applied.md lists at least one commit and every commit it names exists in the repo.

steps.title: pull-request
steps.done_when: the agent reports pr.md; its checks exit 0
steps.command: url=$(grep -oE 'https://github\.com/[^/ ]+/[^/ ]+/pull/[0-9]+' .moor/artifacts/pr.md | head -n1); [ -n "$url" ] && [ "$(gh pr view "$url" --json state --jq .state)" = OPEN ]

checks.run: url=$(grep -oE 'https://github\.com/[^/ ]+/[^/ ]+/pull/[0-9]+' .moor/artifacts/pr.md | head -n1); [ -n "$url" ] && [ "$(gh pr view "$url" --json state --jq .state)" = OPEN ]
checks.says: pr.md holds a pull request URL and that pull request is open.
